label: Cube Spin
blurb: The picture is one side of a cube that turns away in 3D; the next clip is the side that turns in. For the full cube with both sides on screen together, put the next clip on the track above, overlapping by the spin length, with this effect on both. On a straight cut the first side turns away, then the next turns in. Use Progress to key it by hand. The track below shows round the cube.

params.label: When
choices: In at the start and out at the end
